items.title: Cloudflare DDoS Threat Report H1 2026: 1 Tbps attacks soar as DNS floods and geopolitical tensions drive a new wave
items.summary: In the first half of 2026, Cloudflare detected a 519% surge in hyper-volumetric DDos attacks across its network. These attacks were driven heavily by DNS and CLDAP reflection vectors. This report breaks down how major geopolitical conflicts reshaped the global cyber threat landscape.

items.summary: Doodle Scan is a client-side only background remover with additional tools for working with drawings and sketches

items.title: Everything we launched during Agents Week
items.summary: Our latest Agents Week has come to a close. Here’s a recap of all the announcements we made from Wallets to Radar.

items.title: Serving the most critical missions: Cloudflare for Government achieves FedRAMP Class D (High) Certified status
items.summary: Cloudflare for Government achieves FedRAMP Class D (High) Certified status. We also announce our commitment to pursue DoD IL4 authorization. Cloudflare brings world-class security, performance, and developer products to the public sector.

items.title: Types of Time Travel Zine
items.summary: I made a zine about the different types of time travel

items.title: Unveiling good and bad behaviors on the Agentic Internet
items.summary: Cloudflare is shifting bot mitigation from point-in-time Risk assessment to continuous Trust evaluation. Learn how new good and bad behaviors from bots and agents are assessed by our systems, including BotBase and Precursor — and try out our Precursor Trace simulation to see how your own cursor movements would be assessed as human or bot.

items.title: Introducing Radar Researcher: An AI tool for exploring Internet data in plain language
items.summary: Cloudflare Radar Researcher is a new AI-powered tool that lets you explore global Internet trends and traffic data using plain language. Built entirely on Cloudflare's Developer Platform, it turns natural language queries into real, interactive charts.

items.title: Announcing Cloudflare Ambassadors, Community Engineers, and another $1M in open-source funding
items.summary: We are launching updated community programs, including Cloudflare Ambassadors and Community Engineers, backed by $1M in open-source funding. Learn how we are supporting maintainers and scaling our developer community.

items.title: Unifying Workers AI and AI Gateway into a single AI control plane
items.summary: Cloudflare is unifying AI Gateway and Workers AI into a single control plane, giving developers observability, billing, and dynamic routing across both managed GPUs and external providers. Learn how unified bindings and model-first routing simplify building resilient AI applications.

items.title: Shutting Down EchoFeed
items.summary: An explanation of why I'm shutting EchoFeed

items.title: Cloudflare AI Search: give your agents a search engine for your data
items.summary: AI Search makes search easier than ever, with no Cloudflare primitives to stitch together. Point it at your data to create a search for your own files and websites. We're also sharing a preview of our new pricing model.

items.title: The next generation of MCP
items.summary: The next version of MCP has a rewritten, stateless core that just works on Workers. We cover upgrades to the protocol, the new feature lifecycle and SDK migration path, and hear from early adopters already running it in production.

items.title: From ranking to recommended: get your site ready to thrive in the age of AI agents
items.summary: More than half of requests now come from machines, not people. Agent Readiness shows how well agents can discover and read your site, while Answer Engine Optimization tracks how often AI assistants recommend you.

items.title: Building an open Agentic Internet: readable, discoverable, callable, and payable
items.summary: Agents are a new kind of visitor. They don't render CSS or click ads, but they have a paying human on the other end. Block them and you block your customer. We're building the open tools and protocols so publishers and agents can cooperate and not collide.

items.title: Introducing Kitesurf: The agent-first browser that runs in V8 isolates on Cloudflare Workers
items.summary: We should be giving all agents tools that excel at what’s important for an AI model. Kitesurf is Cloudflare’s new stateless, highly scalable, and cost-effective web browser that runs entirely on top of Workers and was designed specifically for the Agentic Cloud.

items.title: Give any website a WebMCP interface
items.summary: Today we're launching a developer preview of WebMCP on Cloudflare. With one switch, any site becomes usable by browser AI agents — no new APIs, no origin changes — while the human stays in control and creators keep their traffic.

items.title: Cloudflare is the only vendor named a Visionary in 2026 SASE and SSE reports
items.summary: We're honored to announce that Cloudflare is the only vendor that has been recognized as a Visionary in both the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for SASE Platforms and the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Security Service Edge reports.

items.title: The Agent Access Model
items.summary: The Agent Access Model proposes a new architecture to secure task-scoped agents using strict identity brokering, continuous mediation, and stateful trust.

items.title: How we’re rethinking work at Cloudflare with Cloudflare OS
items.summary: We built Cloudflare OS to equip our teams to safely rethink how they get work done with AI. The platform brings together the best of our technologies, from our Compute primitives to our Zero Trust suite. This post walks through our journey to give our users the best AI tools available.

items.title: Cloudflare OS: an open platform for agents, apps, and work
items.summary: Cloudflare OS is an open-source platform that lets everyone in your company build apps, automate work, and safely access internal systems, shaped around what your organization knows and how it operates

items.title: WriteGuard: fine-grained controls for MCP Servers
items.summary: At Cloudflare, we knew we could not depend on every employee to configure every agent perfectly or watch every tool call. Before expanding write access across our own internal MCP servers, we built WriteGuard. We are now bringing those controls to Cloudflare MCP server portals through a private beta.

items.title: Catching rogue AI behavior with identity-aware analytics
items.summary: Identity-aware AI Gateway is now in open beta. User Insights turns that traffic into a behavioral baseline for every person and agent, and flags insider risk the moment it appears.
